fact_check.claim: First-years (fall entrants to Aug 31, spring entrants to Dec 31), PhD students and graduate assistants ride free at all hours; Cornell ID is the pass
fact_check.note: brief §2 and Cornell bus pass page fetched 2026-11-08: new first-years automatic OmniRide, expiring Aug 31 (fall) / Dec 31 (spring); PhD and graduate assistants free OmniRide.

fact_check.claim: Other registered students ride free after 6 p.m. weekdays and all day Saturday and Sunday
fact_check.note: Matches Cornell page (enrolled a year or more: free after 6 p.m. weekdays, all weekend).

fact_check.claim: OmniRide $200 a year, prorated monthly, MyParking.Cornell.Edu, refund until Mar 31 less $40, expires Aug 31 of next year, activation up to 24 hours, cash fare $1.50
fact_check.note: All confirmed on the Cornell page and in brief §2.

fact_check.claim: Break-even about 134 paid rides (200 / 1.50)
fact_check.note: Recomputed: 200/1.5 = 133.3, so 134 rides. The brief's cross-source table said 133; corrected to 134 there.

fact_check.claim: About 4.5 paid rides a week over an assumed 30-week year
fact_check.note: 134/30 = 4.47, rounds to 4.5; page labels the 30 weeks as an assumption.

fact_check.claim: Junior example: 10 paid rides a week, $15 a week, passes 134 rides in about 14 weeks
Sophomore example: 4 paid rides a week, 120 over 30 weeks, $180 vs $200
Spring 2027 entrant's pass ends Dec 31, 2027; fall entrants' pass ends Aug 31, 2027; timeline dates

fact_check.claim: Transfers ride free in their first year (Cornell Sun reporter's statement, GM quoted only on evening/weekend rides)
fact_check.note: Sun fetched: freshmen and transfer students get free OmniRide; GM quote only on overrides. Brief §2 agrees; page hedges properly.

fact_check.claim: Cornell updated eligibility list Oct 16, 2024 after a farebox glitch let all students ride free; magstripe IDs work poorly; drivers override rejected IDs in free hours
fact_check.note: Confirmed in the Sun article (Oct. 16, compatibility problem, magstripes, override on nights and weekends).

fact_check.claim: Cornell ended free passes for continuing students in 2007

fact_check.note: Cornell page: spouses of students 90 and 92; continuing-ed and employee spouses 90, 92, 93. Page's hedge is accurate.

fact_check.claim: Johnson MBA page: free first year, then free after 6 p.m. weekdays and all weekend
fact_check.note: brief MBA row.

fact_check.claim: Phone numbers: Transportation Services 607-255-4600; Registrar 607-255-4232; TCAT 607-277-RIDE, Mon-Fri 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
fact_check.note: First two confirmed on Cornell page; TCAT line and hours in brief.

fact_check.note: Fetched; all confirmed. Page's 'four' numbered list merges the two T-card types, fine.

fact_check.claim: Route 32 weekdays, Route 72 weekends (airport page)
